name: Ear for Music
source: Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
body:
Drawbacks
Ear for Music
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Shelyn
You spent countless hours of your youth in one of Shelyn’s temples, listening to wonderful musicians and singers. You gain a +1 trait bonus on one category of Perform checks and a +2 trait bonus on Knowledge (local) checks that deal with the local art or music scene.
